job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Core Reliability
job.pay_full: $186,065 – $218,900 a year base salary (excluding equity and bonus)

details.about: This role sits on the Infra Reliability team within Coinbase's Platform group, helping Coinbase scale 50x by improving reliability, security and deployment safety. The team owns the systems that secure service configurations and secrets, reduce customer-facing incidents and strengthen deployment infrastructure for thousands of services and hundreds of daily releases.
duties: Own the design and delivery of reliability projects and features across Coinbase's services, with other engineering teams
Work with critical T0/T1 services to understand their architecture, improve scalability and cut operational toil
Build systems that securely manage service configurations and secrets at scale
Improve canary-based release systems to support thousands of services and hundreds of daily deployments with fewer incidents
Drive reliability best practices across engineering
needs: 5+ years of software engineering building and maintaining production services in service-oriented architectures, including Ruby, Go, Terraform and AWS, GCP or Azure
Designing and operating reliable, high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems at scale, with well-tested production code
Observability and monitoring tools such as Kibana or Datadog to debug production issues and reduce incidents
Communicating architecture decisions in writing and verbally to engineering stakeholders
Taking part in on-call rotations outside normal business hours
Using generative AI tools responsibly with human oversight
details.benefits: Base salary $186,065 – $218,900 a year, varying by location (excluding equity and bonus). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401(k).
notes: Remote-first: expect quarterly in-person working sessions
Candidates may submit up to 3 applications in a 6-month period
